editorial.blurb: This vibrant taco spot elevates the classics with quality ingredients, creative salsas like their signature habanero, and thoughtful touches like Oaxaca cheese layered between tortillas.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the habanero salsa — reviewers rave about it — and ask for the Lomo or Spicy Taco tacos; takeout is lightning-fast (around 15 mins) and a great value at $13 for three tacos with generous portions.
